{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk shantung sheath dress, A-line cut falling to the mid-calf, color champagne gold (#F5E6CA), woven silk with a subtle textured sheen.
Pointed-toe stiletto pumps, sleek silhouette in a classic pump style, color charcoal grey (#36454F), smooth calfskin leather.
Pearl drop earrings, round pearl beads suspended from a thin chain, color white (#FFFFFF), cultured freshwater pearls with an 18k gold setting.

This outfit works perfectly for your friend's wedding as it balances the formality required for a daytime restaurant reception with autumnal sophistication. The champagne silk sheath dress offers an elegant silhouette appropriate for a formal event without appearing overly heavy for the afternoon hour, while the charcoal pumps ground the look with a modern touch. Finally, the pearl earrings add a classic, timeless detail that complements your golden attire and respects the celebratory nature of the occasion."}
